item.title: Psychiatry Weekly: At-Home Igalmi and the Sublocade Study
item.description:
The FDA approves the first at-home treatment for agitation in schizophrenia and bipolar disorder, an industry-funded Ontario study on extended-release buprenorphine and overdose, and phase 3 readouts in mania and depression. Neuropsychiatry and consultation-liaison were quiet.

Sources:

  • Sublocade research offers strongest protection against fentanyl overdose (CTV/CP24)
  • Impact of opioid agonist therapies on non-fatal and fatal overdose (Frontiers in Public Health, via PMC)
  • U.S. Drug Overdose Deaths Decrease for 18th Consecutive Month Under Trump Administration (White House/ONDCP)

  • November 2026 Issues of APA Journals Feature New Research on Psilocybin Use, Home-Based Neuromodulation for Depression, Veteran Mental Health, and More

item.title: Queen's Domain: The Two-Person Hit
item.description:
A look at Queen's Domain, a retro first-person fantasy action RPG made by a two-person team. We cover the premise, how it plays, early reviews, and its strong first week of sales.

Sources:

  • Queen's Domain Review (RPG Site)

  • Queen's Domain Crosses 10K Concurrent Players — Best Price & Impressions (DLCompare)
  • Retro Action-RPG Queen's Domain Breaks Out as Commercial and Critical Hit (Enduins)

item.title: Psychiatry Weekly: Psilocybin NDA and Methadone After Overdose
item.description:
Compass Pathways completes its NDA for COMP360 in treatment-resistant depression, a Canadian cohort compares methadone and buprenorphine after overdose, and overdose deaths keep falling. Plus a quiet week in consultation-liaison and neuropsychiatry, and a round-up.

Sources:

  • NDA Submission Complete: COMP360 Psilocybin for Treatment-Resistant Depression
  • Methadone vs Buprenorphine-Naloxone in Opioid Overdose Survivors (JAMA Netw Open)
  • Methadone Treatment After Opioid Overdose Associated With 22% Lower Mortality Than Buprenorphine-Naloxone (OPEN MINDS)
  • This Congress has one last chance to unlock methadone treatment (Reason)
  • U.S. drug overdose deaths falling, CDC estimates, but some areas still struggling (Axios, search snippet only)
  • Private equity is buying up more methadone clinics (Cobb County Courier, search snippet only)
